The code will be deleted and the connection dropped. The assistant returns to a normal model.
The old code stops working — the agent will have to connect again with the new one.

The connection runs through a public relay, but the contents are encrypted with a key derived from your code — the relay sees only ciphertext. The agent has to stay running: close the sandbox and the connection is gone.

Connect to my Zephyr browser as an AI assistant.

1. Save the attached script as zephyr_link.py
2. Run:
 export ZEPHYR_CODE=%1$s
 export ZEPHYR_SERVER=%2$s
 export ZEPHYR_AGENT="your name"
 python3 zephyr_link.py hello
3. Then loop:
 python3 zephyr_link.py listen # waits for a question, prints JSON, exits
 (think for yourself)
 python3 zephyr_link.py reply --id ID "your answer"

These tiers are free and always available:

• Google Gemini — 1500 requests a day, key at aistudio.google.com
• Groq — very fast Llama 3.3 70B, console.groq.com
• OpenRouter — models with the :free suffix

Put two or three such keys into the swarm and the assistant stays available even while the agent is asleep.
Gemini and Groq presets are already in the provider list
